body:
Follow-up to `selfrep-redesign`: replaces its assumed 0.9 wood-rod penalty with Euler–Bernoulli beam theory. Hardwood sags 20× steel at 8 mm and needs ~17 mm to match; the earlier 30 g/dowel was ~2× the geometric mass (mass closure 35.8% → 34.6%). Stylised: material properties and load are assumed. 6 tests, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
